title: Just made a short HTML game based on sentiments surrounding AI.
author: The_Amazing_Bastard
selftext:
It's a small satirical project that turns these ongoing discussions into a playable experience. The gameplay is just a vehicle for the story. While I think the gameplay itself is somewhat generic, I really enjoyed polishing it, even for such a short experience.

This is the second game I've worked on, but the first one I've actually released. My other project is more complex a turn-based RPG built in Godot using a 2.5D approach.

I've found that free-tier AI tools are usually enough for my development needs. Maybe I'm just a procrastinator.

I also don't see cute anime-style games shared here very often, so I hope this is welcome!

[https://chevalbakunawa.itch.io/thegreatchibirebellion](https://chevalbakunawa.itch.io/thegreatchibirebellion)

comments.body: u/The_Amazing_Bastard please update this post with more on how you used AI to build the game. A line saying it was made with AI isn't enough. Share dev details. Rule 4 is there so promotional posts add to the sub by talking about the process and real development. We don't want the sub drowned in empty promotion. Posts that aren't updated may be removed.
